headline: Eskom Confirms Retirement of Group CFO Calib Cassim
summary: Eskom confirmed the retirement of Group Chief Financial Officer Calib Cassim, adding that he will continue to serve in an acting capacity.
why: CFO transitions at state-owned power utilities impact financial oversight, debt restructuring efforts, and operational accountability.
